com.ecom.admin.release_notes: Network gateway window: shops that cannot be linked now say why before you press anything, linked shops show who will confirm their network and whether that person can receive a text, and first sightings are listed separately from changed addresses. Shops that finished their launch are linked automatically.

com.ecom.order.release_notes: Shop network confirmation: when the owner has more than one shop, the manager signed in at the shop confirms a network change with a code texted to the manager's own mobile. A single-shop owner still confirms on the owner's mobile. The screens now say who receives the code.
